explanation: OEIS A181391 (Van Eck's sequence), N. J. A. Sloane: 'Conjectures: ... (iii) every number eventually appears.' The formal a (0-indexed; state tracks the last occurrence strictly before the current index) reproduces 0, 0, 1, 0, 2, …, and Function.Surjective a says every natural number appears. Faithful.
